data.title: 圣女贞德 · 晨光小教堂的祈祷·「今日也请，赐予他们安宁」
data.description: 【乡野小教堂·清晨】晨光斜斜地穿过高窗，落在跪于祭坛前的贞德身上。她已卸下胸铠，只着素白的Ruler礼裙，双手合十抵着额头，金色的长辫安静地垂过腰际。睫毛在圣光下泛着细软的金边，唇间流淌着为逝者与生者诵出的祷词——连尘埃都在光柱里缓缓起伏，仿佛应和着圣女的呼吸。
data.action: 跪于祭坛前双手合十祈祷，白裙金辫垂落，晨光光柱笼罩周身
data.lighting: 高窗斜射的丁达尔晨光光柱，尘埃微粒浮游其间
data.camera: medium shot, kneel profile, god rays through window, serene sacred mood
data.promptProse: Jeanne kneels at the small chapel altar, ungloved hands joined against her forehead and eyes closed above a plain opaque white long-sleeved prayer dress. Her golden braid rests down her back after armor is set aside. The medium side view places a nearby bench behind her and the modest altar ahead. Slanting sunrise beams illuminate joined fingers and dress folds, carrying floating dust above the shaded floor and bench legs.
